messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Relevan announcements from ICES. Circulate please.

Best

EJ

-------- Original Message --------
Subject: 	ICES Training courses 2012
Date: 	Tue, 13 Dec 2011 21:07:36 +0100
From: 	S?ren Anker Pedersen <sorenap at ices.dk>
To: 	S?ren Anker Pedersen <sorenap at ices.dk>



***Please distribute to other interested parties.***

The ICES Training Programme is pleased to announce the following 
training courses for 2012:

?Introduction to Bayesian Inference in Fishery Science: 11-15 June 2012

?Analysing and visualization of VMS and EU logbook data using the 
VMStools  R package: 25-29 June 2012

?Stock assessment introduction:  9-13 July 2012

?Opening the box: Stock Assessment and Fisheries advice for 
stakeholders, NGOs and policy makers: 9-11 October 2012

Details about the courses are found in the attached announcement flyers.

Could you kindly display the announcement on your institute/department 
notice board or via your intranet? Thank you.

For more information about ICES Training Programme visit the Training 
web page: www.ices.dk/iceswork/training/training.asp 
<http://www.ices.dk/iceswork/training/training.asp>

More courses are under development and will be announced from the 
Training web page.

Communicating Science and Advice; Training for ICES expert group Chairs; 
How to Lead an Effective Technical Meeting

Best regards,

On behalf of the ICES Science Committee Training Group

S?ren Anker Pedersen
Coordinator for Training
International Council for the Exploration of the Sea

Direct:  +45 33 38 67 52

Skype:  sapices
e-mail:sorenap at ices.dk <mailto:sorenap at ices.dk>
Web:_www.ices.dk/iceswork/training/training.asp_

2nd ICES/PICES Conference for Early Career Scientists "Oceans of Change"

Palma de Mallorca, Spain, April 2012

*http://www.ices.dk/marineworld/oceans/index.asp*
